ActionDescriptions.ToAddDeterministicScheduledTask:
to add a deterministic scheduled task
Guide creation of deterministic scheduled ProtoScript tasks that do not call an LLM or use model tokens.
ActionDescriptions.ToAddRecurringProcess:
to create an interval system process
Creates or updates an interval-driven process. processName, handlerAssembly, handlerType, and runEveryMinutes are required. runDataJson may be empty.
ActionDescriptions.ToAddScheduledTask:
to create an external scheduled task
Creates or updates an external prompt-driven scheduled task. handlerAssembly, handlerType, processName, sessionKey, promptContext, and instruction are required. createChildSession controls whether each run creates a child session.
ActionDescriptions.ToDiagnoseBuffalyProcessFailure:
to troubleshoot a Buffaly process failure
Read-only guided diagnosis of one process's last-run state, bounded logs, configuration, and known dependency health. Never prints secrets or enables, disables, triggers, or repairs the process.
ActionDescriptions.ToDisableBuffalyProcess:
to disable a scheduled task
processID - numeric Processes.ProcessID to disable.
ActionDescriptions.ToEnableBuffalyProcess:
to enable a scheduled task
processID - numeric Processes.ProcessID to enable.
ActionDescriptions.ToExplainHowToAddRecurringProcess:
to explain how to add a recurring process
Explain and guide creation of a recurring interval system process using ProcessManagement tools.

Before SSM, discover typed tools/APIs, inspect contracts and load suitable tools. Prefer them; justify SSM in the approval request only if alternatives cannot meet the need. Existing approvals and restrictions apply.
ActionDescriptions.ToExplainHowToAddScheduledTask:
to explain how to add a scheduled task
Explain and guide creation of an external prompt-driven scheduled task using ProcessManagement tools.

Before SSM, discover typed tools/APIs, inspect contracts and load suitable tools. Prefer them; justify SSM in the approval request only if alternatives cannot meet the need. Existing approvals and restrictions apply.
ActionDescriptions.ToGetBuffalyProcessDetails:
to inspect a scheduled process
processID - numeric Processes.ProcessID to inspect.
ActionDescriptions.ToListBuffalyProcesses:
to list all process rows
Lists all Buffaly processes as compact summaries without raw RunData. Use ToGetBuffalyProcessDetails for full row data, validation, and raw RunData.
ActionDescriptions.ToListRecurringProcesses:
to list interval system processes
Lists interval-driven recurring processes as compact summaries: ProcessID, ProcessName, status flags, timing, handler, SessionKey, and PromptContext. Use ToGetBuffalyProcessDetails for raw RunData/details.
ActionDescriptions.ToListScheduledTasks:
to list external scheduled tasks
Lists externally triggered scheduled tasks as compact summaries: ProcessID, ProcessName, status flags, timing, handler, SessionKey, and PromptContext. Use ToGetBuffalyProcessDetails for raw RunData/details.
ActionDescriptions.ToRunIntervalProcessNow:
to manually run an interval system process
Runs only an enabled process whose Action is IntervalSystemProcess. ExternalScheduledTask rows must use ToTriggerScheduledTaskNow. processID - numeric Processes.ProcessID to run immediately.
ActionDescriptions.ToTriggerScheduledTaskNow:
to run an external scheduled task now
Runs only a process whose Action is ExternalScheduledTask. Do not use this action for IntervalSystemProcess rows; use ToRunIntervalProcessNow instead. processName - exact external scheduled-task name. triggerKey may be empty when the row has no ExternalTriggerKey configured.
ActionDescriptions.ToValidateBuffalyProcessConfiguration:
to validate a scheduled process
processID - numeric Processes.ProcessID to validate.
